title: Social Security and Medicare Trustees Reports
summary: This Treasury page serves as a navigation hub linking to annual Social Security and Medicare Trustees Reports, which provide Congress with financial accounting and projections for these trust funds. The page contains no substantive content from the actual reports themselves.
key_points: The Secretary of the Treasury serves as Chair of the Boards of Trustees for Social Security and Medicare
The Board comprises six trustees: three federal officials (Social Security Commissioner, HHS Secretary, Labor Secretary) and two Senate-confirmed public members
Annual trustees reports provide Congress with current and projected financial status of both trust funds
The page provides links to separate Social Security Report, Medicare Report, and a combined Summary

However, this navigation page provides no actual report content or findings.
